evals.expected_output: Returns an implementation review report with Architecture, Design, Devex, Security, Testing, Fix Priority, Advisor Budget Report, and Completion Status sections.
expectations: Every finding includes a file/line or verified command output
Phase 1 and Phase 2 findings keep [P1] and [P2] provenance markers
Advisor calls are counted and capped by --advisor-budget
Confidence Gate band maps to DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, BLOCKED, or NEEDS_CONTEXT

evals.expected_output: Builds one review target from staged, unstaged, untracked, and deleted source changes without creating a commit. It supplies tracked diffs and untracked file contents to the review workers, and returns NEEDS_CONTEXT rather than an all-clear report when no reviewable source files are present.
expectations: Does not combine --working-tree with --code or --git-range
Deduplicates paths across staged and unstaged change lists
Includes deleted (D) paths so removing a critical-path file cannot bypass the gate
Includes type-changed (T) paths, such as a tracked file replaced by a symlink, so the change cannot bypass the gate
Excludes ignored generated directories and files, for tracked and untracked paths alike

evals.name: valid-base-merge-base-boundary
evals.expected_output: Resolves main with git rev-parse --verify main^{commit}, computes git merge-base main HEAD, rejects an empty merge-base...HEAD diff, and reports both supplied ref and resolved merge-base.
expectations: Uses one mutually exclusive target mode.
Uses the same merge-base...HEAD range for names, patch, and final contents sent to every Phase 1 worker.
Does not reinterpret explicit --git-range semantics.

evals.name: base-needs-context-errors
evals.prompt: Review with --base missing-ref, then review with --base main when the merge-base diff is empty or the refs have no common ancestor.
evals.expected_output: Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT for unresolved refs, no common ancestor, or empty merge-base-to-HEAD diffs before reading review files.
expectations: Does not emit an all-clear report for an empty diff.
Reports supplied ref and failure reason where available.
Treats a failed git merge-base operation as NEEDS_CONTEXT.

evals.name: mixed-target-rejection
evals.expected_output: Rejects mixed or missing target modes with NEEDS_CONTEXT before reading code or spec files.
expectations: Treats --base as mutually exclusive with --git-range, --code, and --working-tree.

evals.name: explicit-range-compatibility
evals.expected_output: Keeps explicit two-endpoint A..B review semantics and does not substitute merge-base behavior.
expectations: Preserves --git-range compatibility.
Rejects combining --git-range with --base.

evals.name: worker-three-dot-propagation
evals.prompt: Review a valid fixed-point branch with --base main and inspect the Phase 1 worker packets.
evals.expected_output: Every Phase 1 worker receives the identical merge-base...HEAD file list, patch boundary, and final contents, with report-header evidence for supplied ref and resolved merge-base.

evals.name: base-no-common-ancestor
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-impl-review --spec docs/specification/03-behavior.md --base unrelated-root when unrelated-root has no common ancestor with HEAD.
evals.expected_output: Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT for the failed git merge-base operation before reading review files or reporting an all-clear result.

evals.name: architecture-packet-positive
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-impl-review --spec docs/specification/03-behavior.md --working-tree --manifest architecture-invariants.json --architecture-evidence .ywc-architecture-invariants-evidence.json with a valid bounded audit.
evals.expected_output: The Architecture worker receives only the sanitized packet. Helper status remains dispatch status; aggregate_verdict becomes invariant_verdict; rule_results rule IDs become rule_ids; sanitized evidence paths remain bounded finding citations; contract_state is VALIDATED and evidence_artifact_path names the artifact.
expectations: No raw evidence, transcript, command-like field, or full diff is included in the architecture packet
The packet is advisory evidence and cannot alter merge authority

evals.name: architecture-packet-no-evidence
evals.expected_output: Preserves the existing review flow with no architecture packet and does not report a fabricated violation for missing evidence.

evals.name: architecture-packet-invalid-evidence
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-impl-review --spec docs/specification/03-behavior.md --working-tree --manifest architecture-invariants.json --architecture-evidence invalid.json containing a forbidden or unknown field.
evals.expected_output: Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT before worker dispatch and does not forward invalid evidence, raw diagnostic output, transcripts, or command-like fields.

evals.name: architecture-packet-violation
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-impl-review --spec docs/specification/03-behavior.md --working-tree --manifest architecture-invariants.json --architecture-evidence forbidden-edge.json where aggregate_verdict is VIOLATED.
evals.expected_output: Reports an Architecture finding with invariant_verdict VIOLATED, affected rule IDs, and sanitized evidence paths, while keeping the packet advisory and not escalating reviewer or merge authority.
